title: Strings and Interpolation
scenario: Strings are written in double quotes. Interpolation embeds an expression inside a string. Complete the greeting output.

focus.title: Complete the greeting output

hints.why: HCL is the language Terraform evaluates. Small syntax mistakes here turn into confusing plan errors later, so slow, deliberate practice pays off.
hints.what: Complete the marked region in `outputs.tf`. The work is inside `output "greeting"`. Write a quoted string that embeds the variable. Use the visible constraints as the checklist for names, values and references before you run the tests.
hints.when: Reach for this whenever you add a new block or argument by hand rather than copying generated code.
hints.how: Open `outputs.tf` and work only inside `output "greeting"`. Use this code shape: value. Use the already-declared references instead of hardcoded values: `var.app_name`. Keep the block header and braces, indent nested blocks by two spaces, and add one argument or nested block at a time. Run the tests after each small change so the first failure points at the next name to fix.
